metaDescription: London Deck Builder won our 2026 Deck Building award for London, Ontario. See their materials, 5-year warranty, client feedback and service area.
summary: London Deck Builder constructs pressure-treated, cedar, composite and PVC decks for homeowners across London and Southwestern Ontario. The company backs its work with a 5-year workmanship warranty and is known for permit assistance alongside the build itself.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: London Deck Builder builds decks in pressure-treated wood, cedar, composite and PVC, plus deck lighting and features, and offers repair and maintenance on existing decks. That range means a homeowner can go from a first consultation through material choice, permit application, and eventual upkeep with the same company.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company includes deck permit assistance as a named service, which matters in Ontario since most raised decks require a building permit from the local municipality. It backs new builds with a 5-year workmanship warranty and is described as transparent on pricing, which homeowners should confirm covers materials and labour separately.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One review describes a project where the builder doubled the size of an existing deck and blended new construction seamlessly with the old, a harder technical job than building from scratch. A second reviewer highlighted the planning stage specifically, saying the team's input shaped a design that was both practical and visually finished.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: London Deck Builder serves London, St. Thomas, Woodstock and the surrounding Southwestern Ontario region. Homeowners near the edges of that area should confirm the company will travel for their project before requesting a quote.

strengths: Builds in four common decking materials, from budget pressure-treated wood to low-maintenance composite and PVC.
Includes permit assistance, which removes a common friction point in Ontario deck projects.
Backs new builds with a 5-year workmanship warranty.
Handles deck repair and maintenance, not just new construction, useful for extending an existing deck's life.
Reviews specifically mention successful blending of new construction onto an existing deck, a harder job than a fresh build.
considerations: Best suited to full deck builds or additions rather than very small repair jobs; ask if minimum project size applies.
Composite and PVC decking cost more upfront than pressure-treated wood, so budget-focused homeowners should ask for a like-for-like comparison.
Permit timelines are set by the municipality, not the builder, so expect the permit step to add lead time before construction starts.
Not a fit if you need fencing or retaining wall work in the same visit; this business is deck-focused.
Very small repair or single-board fixes may fall below the company's typical project scope, so ask before booking.
bestFor: Homeowners planning a new deck build in pressure-treated wood, cedar, composite or PVC
Anyone extending or blending new construction onto an existing deck
Homeowners who want permit handling included rather than managed separately
Properties needing deck lighting, added features, or repair to an aging deck
questionsToAsk: Does the quote include permit application and inspection fees, or just construction?
What footing depth and fastener type do you use for our soil and frost conditions?
How does the 5-year workmanship warranty differ from the material manufacturer's warranty?
Can you match new construction to an existing deck if we are extending rather than rebuilding?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: London Deck Builder was chosen through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top deck builder serving London, Ontario. Selection is based on public services, reviews and service area information, and no business pays a fee to be considered or to win.

faq.q: Do they help with the building permit?
faq.a: Yes, deck permit assistance is listed among their services, which can simplify a step many homeowners find confusing when they are planning a deck on their own.

faq.q: What decking materials do they offer?
faq.a: Pressure-treated wood, cedar, composite and PVC, giving homeowners a range from budget-friendly to low-maintenance options.

faq.q: Is there a warranty on new decks?
faq.a: The company offers a 5-year workmanship warranty on its builds. Ask what specifically it covers before signing a contract.
